profile.name: Tashreef Muhammad
profile.positioning: I build sequence models and the datasets they are missing.
profile.summary: My main line of work is time-series and financial machine learning — transformer architectures, temporal representation, and the measurement problems that appear when panel data is unevenly covered. Alongside it I build annotated corpora for low-resource Bangla and work on explainable deep learning for medical and agricultural imaging.

research.heading: Sequence modelling and financial machine learning
research.body: Transformers and learned temporal encodings such as Time2Vec were built for language; moving them into financial forecasting exposes problems that language never had — irregular coverage, regime change, and thin markets. I work on the Dhaka Stock Exchange because those problems are unavoidable there, and I release the panel data and coverage metadata so results can actually be reproduced.
threads: Transformer forecasting with learned time representation
Temporal coverage bias in panel construction
Benchmarking classical and deep forecasters on commodity prices

research.heading: Low-resource Bangla NLP
research.body: Bangla has more than 230 million speakers and almost no computational resources for its regional varieties. I build the annotated corpora first — dialect translation pairs, regional named entities, dialectal hate speech — and then the baselines, so that the benchmark outlives any single model.

research.heading: Explainable AI for medical and agricultural imaging
research.body: A diagnostic model that cannot show its reasoning does not get used by the people it was built for. I pair vision transformers and CNN ensembles with post-hoc interpretation, and evaluate whether the explanations land on the anatomy or the lesion a specialist would point at.
threads: Diabetic retinopathy screening from heterogeneous fundus data
Plant leaf disease detection for smallholder agriculture
Grad-CAM, LIME and SHAP as evaluation targets, not decoration
